This plot is not mine, it is rented, so I do not want to put too much money into it. I have no cash for chemical fertilizer this year, and the bag is too big for such a small piece of land anyway. I will carry some manure from my animals like I always do, and use the seed I saved from last year — that is what my neighbors do too. The rains here in Tigray have been poor the last seasons, so I will not risk cash I do not have. My wife and children will help me weed and harvest, and I will not hire anyone for such a small plot.
